name: ternlux
author: Ternlux Inc
description: Visual data workflow builder — connect databases and files, transform with SQL, and schedule pipelines.

scripts.electron-dev: concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none DANGEROUSLY_DISABLE_HOST_CHECK=true react-scripts start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.electron-pack: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/ensure-mac-prebuilts.js && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --mac -c.directories.output=$HOME/Ternlux-dist; }
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js linux_amd64 && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && node scripts/ensure-linux-prebuilts.js stage && { electron-builder --linux -c.npmRebuild=false; s=$?; node scripts/ensure-linux-prebuilts.js restore; exit $s; }
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js windows_amd64 && node scripts/ensure-win-prebuilts.js && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --win; }
scripts.dist:all: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js --all && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && electron-builder --mac --linux --win
scripts.pack:mac: node scripts/ensure-mac-prebuilts.js && node scripts/minify-dist.js && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --mac -c.directories.output=$HOME/Ternlux-dist; }
scripts.pack:linux: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js linux_amd64 && node scripts/minify-dist.js && node scripts/ensure-linux-prebuilts.js stage && { electron-builder --linux -c.npmRebuild=false; s=$?; node scripts/ensure-linux-prebuilts.js restore; exit $s; }
scripts.pack:win: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js windows_amd64 && node scripts/ensure-win-prebuilts.js && node scripts/minify-dist.js && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --win; }
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/ensure-mac-prebuilts.js && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --mac --publish always -c.directories.output=$HOME/Ternlux-dist; }
scripts.release:win: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js windows_amd64 && node scripts/ensure-win-prebuilts.js && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --win --publish always; }
scripts.release:linux: node scripts/fetch-duckdb-extensions.js linux_amd64 && react-scripts build && node scripts/minify-dist.js && node scripts/ensure-linux-prebuilts.js stage && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; electron-builder --linux --publish always -c.npmRebuild=false; s=$?; node scripts/ensure-linux-prebuilts.js restore; exit $s; }
